notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts gives only name and county. Mapcarta is a map-derived listing (OpenStreetMap and GeoNames), used only for existence and county. No build, staffing, fire or condition source was found. The Oklahoma Forestry history (ag.ok.gov/ofs-history/) describes state towers generally and does not name this one, so it is not used. The Forest Lookouts Oklahoma index also lists a separate entry named SIGNAL under McCurtain County, not checked; it may be a different tower. Asterisks in that index are unexplained and were not used. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads. Story is 107 words, below the 120 minimum, because no further evidence was found.
